product.name: Linguist Localization
product.description: A traditional localization service where expert translators work on game content using MagnaPlay's platform tools.

product.name: AI/MT Localization
product.description: An AI and machine translation-based localization service designed for fast turnaround and large volume game content translation.

product.name: Centralized Operations
product.description: A platform solution to centralize and organize all localization activities, including in-house and external vendor management.

product.name: Live Ops & Small Batches
product.description: A platform integration that allows continuous localization of game content as strings change or are added in small batches.
